csv.probabilities: uncalibrated; finite [0,1]; sum tolerance 1e-6; no abstention
csv.tie_break: argmax; lowest numbered tone wins exact ties

lifecycle: Exclusive opened/ claim before model access; opening-receipt.json; no automatic retries; completion receipt written last. Missing completion receipt means incomplete; no exclusions or fallback.

const.unit: speaker; all clips; with replacement; paired A/B

interpretation.const: Speaker-bootstrap descriptive uncertainty from only 18 speakers, not population guarantees. Intervals including zero are suggestive, not demonstrated superiority. Bootstrap results do not alter the preregistered decision.

review_template: Primary coverage, uncalibrated probabilities, all failed rule conditions, mixed-results caveat, speaker-bootstrap uncertainty, secondary source-declared status caveat, complete results JSON and bootstrap intervals. Rendered by review() in hashed runner.
